cudaq_rag.name: CUDA-Q RAG Assistant
cudaq_rag.description: Intelligent QA assistant for NVIDIA CUDA-Q quantum computing framework. Features a dual-track ingestion pipeline parsing documentation and academic GitHub repos with LaTeX formula conversion and semantic vector retrieval.

egfr_pipeline.name: EGFR-TKI Resistance Pipeline
egfr_pipeline.description: Cancer genomics pipeline analyzing lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) data from TCGA. Examines co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity of sensitizing vs. resistance mutations in the EGFR kinase domain.

qingjian.name: Qingjian 青简
qingjian.description: Cross-platform pinyin input method that displays contextual word translations alongside candidates in the language being learned. Built in Rust with zero-telemetry local dictionary.

wisdom_weasel.name: Wisdom-Weasel
wisdom_weasel.description: LLM-powered assistant integrated into Rime (Weasel) input method engine for Chinese text autocompletion and contextual prompt suggestions.

antigravity_updater.name: Antigravity Updater
antigravity_updater.description: Automated maintenance and package update tool for developer workstations running Ubuntu.

wake_on_lan.name: Wake-on-LAN Android
wake_on_lan.description: Clean Android utility for waking workstations and servers over local area networks with broadcast magic packets.

usb_sound.name: USB Sound Connect
usb_sound.description: Lightweight native audio hardware connector and switcher for Linux desktop systems.
